mapper.select:
SELECT id, content, type, difficulty, tags, source, source_type, import_hash, option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d, correct_answer, analysis, solution_strategy, category_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM question WHERE status = 1 AND type != 3
AND category_id IN
#{categoryId}
ORDER BY id

SELECT COALESCE(parent.name, c.name) as categoryName, COUNT(q.id) as count FROM category c LEFT JOIN category parent ON c.parent_id = parent.id LEFT JOIN question q ON c.id = q.category_id AND q.type != 3 GROUP BY COALESCE(parent.id, c.id), COALESCE(parent.name, c.name) ORDER BY COUNT(q.id) DESC, COALESCE(parent.name, c.name)

SELECT CASE type WHEN 1 THEN 'Single Choice' WHEN 2 THEN 'Blank' WHEN 4 THEN 'Short Answer' WHEN 5 THEN 'Multiple Choice' ELSE 'Unknown' END as typeName, COUNT(id) as count FROM question WHERE type != 3 GROUP BY type ORDER BY COUNT(id) DESC, type

SELECT id, content, type, difficulty, tags, source, source_type, import_hash, option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d, correct_answer, analysis, solution_strategy, category_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM question WHERE import_hash = #{importHash} LIMIT 1
